name: Western Alps (high alpine)
region: Pennine, Bernese and Mont Blanc massifs; approximate for the Eastern Alps.
sources: Rolland, C. (2003) Spatial and seasonal variations of air temperature lapse rates in Alpine regions. Journal of Climate 16
Frei, C. & Schär, C. (1998) A precipitation climatology of the Alps from high-resolution rain-gauge observations. IJC 18
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Summer convective storms (afternoon thunderstorms) make early starts essential; föhn events bring strong southerly winds.
